prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a hit while turning left. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1410; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient was seen after a collision that occurred while the patient was turning left, in which the head struck a side component of the vehicle. The reported mechanism and force of impact fit the concussion diagnosed. Over 21 visits, care followed a typical course that included symptom monitoring, guidance on cognitive rest, and gradually increased activity. Visit frequency tapered as the patient reported improvement. Most of the documented findings rest on the patient's own descriptions of pain and symptoms. Imaging studies and neurological examination tests have been within normal limits. The patient was also treated for the same body region within the past two years, and that earlier condition may add to some of the current complaints. Two similar billing entries recorded on the same day are under review. The patient is expected to return to normal activities as symptoms resolve.
